newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Premier H1 figures pushed back until Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Premier H1 figures pushed back until Thurs.

text.p: South African foods group Premier Group Ltd said on Tuesday that its interim results will be published a day later than originally announced and will now appear on Thursday.
"There is no reason for it. We just need a bit more time to get the figures together," a Premier spokeswoman said.

Analysts polled by Reuters have forecast earnings per share for the period ranging between 15.0 cents and 16.2 cents, with consensus at 15.6 cents. Premier's previous interim earnings per share was 12.0 cents.
Analysts see the half-year dividend between 4.8 and 5.4 cents, with consensus at 5.1 cents and compared to 4.0 cents previously.
